fusions.name: Drop Forge
fusions.desc: Releases a drop-forge weight onto the target, which deals 30 damage and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Shockwave Anvil
fusions.desc: Slams a steam hammer onto a portable anvil, which deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Beaten Scrap Plate
fusions.desc: Beats a plate of scrap flat across your chest that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and your armour rises by 6%.

fusions.name: Counterweight Swing
fusions.desc: Each critical hit drops a counterweight: your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
